changelog: Hunger/thirst notifications are now a freely movable block (drag in edit mode).
New notification settings: alignment, width, scale, stacking direction.
Deep HUD customization: background color/transparency, borders, shadow, colors, 5 bar styles, spacing, icon size.
Presets (Minimal, Glass, Solid, Floating, Compact) and style export / import.
Fixed 'hide when everything is fine' (now covers stress and bladder) and removed duplicate options.
